title: Thrust Bearing Assembly

introduction.definition: A tilting-pad thrust bearing carries the axial thrust of a rotor on hydrodynamic oil films. Pads arranged around a thrust collar each tilt on a pivot so a converging oil wedge forms; the pressure in the wedges carries the load without metal contact. Double-acting bearings have active and inactive pad sets for thrust in both directions.
applications: Centrifugal compressors, steam and gas turbines
Large pumps, gearboxes and hydro generators
key_points: Pads tilt to form oil wedges
introduction.summary: A tilting-pad thrust bearing carries a rotor's axial load on hydrodynamic oil films. Each pad pivots so an oil wedge forms against the thrust collar; double-acting units carry thrust in both directions.

pressure.title: Oil-film pressure builds toward the trailing edge
pressure.description: Each pad tilts freely on its pivot so a converging oil wedge forms between the rotating collar and the pad face. Oil dragged into the narrowing gap builds hydrodynamic pressure, highest toward the trailing edge, which carries the axial thrust without metal contact (film typically ≈ 10–50 µm). Pad temperature (RTD in the babbitt) is the main health indicator; the inactive pads take reverse thrust during start-up or surge.

thrust.title: Axial thrust
thrust.description: Rotor thrust pushes the collar against the active pads.

video_tutorials.title: Thrust Bearing Assembly — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Thrust Bearing Assembly.
A tilting-pad thrust bearing carries the axial thrust of a rotor on hydrodynamic oil films.
Pads arranged around a thrust collar each tilt on a pivot so a converging oil wedge forms; the pressure in the wedges carries the load without metal contact.
Double-acting bearings have active and inactive pad sets for thrust in both directions.
Typical applications include centrifugal compressors, steam and gas turbines; large pumps, gearboxes and hydro generators.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Rotor Shaft (turning), Thrust Collar (shrunk / integral on the shaft), Bearing Housing with End Seals.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: How the Thrust Bearing Assembly works.
The rotor pushes the collar axially.
Oil is dragged into the wedge between collar and pad.
Film pressure builds toward the trailing edge.
Carrier rings hold the pads; the housing holds oil.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
Each pad tilts freely on its pivot so a converging oil wedge forms between the rotating collar and the pad face.
Rotor thrust pushes the collar against the active pads.

video_tutorials.title: Thrust Bearing Assembly — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Thrust Bearing Assembly.
Trend pad temperatures and axial position.
Check axial float and oil quality.
Inspect pads; replace wiped pads.
Watch for wiped babbitt: high pad temperature, axial shift. Common cause: overload, oil loss, surge.
Watch for collar damage: scoring. Common cause: dirty oil.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
